_comment: App Store Connect の「App Review に関する情報」の「メモ」（審査メモ）。審査の担当者が読むので英語で書く。
言語によらない 1 つの文面。Metadata/App Store を流すと、どの言語を選んでも反映先のバージョンに書き込む。リリースのたびに今のアプリに合っているか見直す。
リポジトリは public。連絡先・デモアカウントは書かない（App Store Connect で手で入れる。ツールも読み書きしない）。
初期値は 1.5.0 の準備中に App Store Connect から取り込んだ値（1.3.0 のときの文面のままだった。#562）。
notes:
Thank you for reviewing version 1.5.0.

- This update focuses on usability. What's new:
  - A "Play Again" button on the Practice and Time Attack result screens starts the next round with the same settings.
  - Time Attack results compare your score with your personal best and your previous play, and show your rank in your records.
  - The Time Attack Records screen (trophy icon on the home screen) shows a score trend graph for each time limit after you play the same difficulty and time limit at least twice.
  - When Time Attack is selected on the home screen, each difficulty button shows your personal best.
  - The app remembers the last selected mode and number of questions.
  - Sound effects and vibration can be turned off separately in Settings (gear icon on the home screen) > Sound & Vibration. Sound effects do not play in Silent Mode.
  - Fixed an issue where "NEW RECORD!" sometimes did not appear after beating a personal best in Time Attack.
- No account or login is required. All features are available right after launch. There are no in-app purchases.
- Google AdMob native ads appear only at the bottom of the result screens, the Time Attack Records screen, and the Settings screen (not on the home screen or during a quiz).
- App Tracking Transparency: the app shows the ATT permission prompt on first launch. If a consent form is required in the user's region (e.g. EEA/UK), Google's consent form appears first. Ads are shown whether or not tracking is allowed. If the prompt does not appear, please make sure "Allow Apps to Request to Track" is turned on in Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking, then reinstall the app.
- In regions where consent is required, users can change their ad consent from Settings > Privacy Settings in the app.
- Privacy policy: https://shilokuma.jp/privacy/prime-pick/ (also available from Settings > Privacy Policy in the app).
